ns0:entry.ns0:title: Limited-time Sale on Optional Items!
ns0:entry.ns0:summary:
Starting Monday, November 2, 2026 at around 12:00 a.m. (PST), the FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store will be hosting a limited-time sale featuring commemorative items from Fan Festival 2023-2024 and earlier!

Visit the FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store.

* The sale will begin after the scheduled maintenance ends on Monday, November 2, 2026 at around 12:00 a.m. (PST). Please visit the News section for detailed maintenance information.
* Please note that there may be a delay in the delivery of items directly after sales commence due to congestion of the delivery system.

ns0:entry.ns0:title: Fan Festival 2026 in Tokyo Live Performance Stream Tickets Now on Sale!
ns0:entry.ns0:summary:
Fan Festival 2026 in Tokyo is nearly here!

For those looking to take their viewing experience to the next level, we will be hosting a piano performance and PRIMALS concert, both available as paid streams via StreamPass and FanStream. You won't want to miss this chance to rock out with Warriors of Light the world over in the comfort of your own home!

If you happen to be too busy to watch live, a ticket purchase also grants access to the archive where the streams can be viewed as many times as you like for a set period. Whether you're at home or on the go, you can enjoy these two amazing concerts at your leisure.

Ticket Prices

Ticket for viewing both days: 4,950 yen (tax included)
* A 770 yen (tax included) system usage fee will be added separately.

Sale Period

Until Saturday, November 21, 2026 at 6:59 a.m. (PST)

Live Stream Schedule

  • Day 1: Piano Concert
    Saturday, October 31 from 3:30 a.m. (PDT) until the end of the performance
  • Day 2: THE PRIMALS
    Sunday, November 1 from 2:00 a.m. (PST) until the end of the performance

* Stage event times are subject to change.

Archive Availability

  • Day 1: Piano Concert
    From Sunday, November 1 at 1:00 a.m. to Sunday, November 22 at 6:59 a.m. (PST)
  • Day 2: THE PRIMALS
    From Monday, November 2 at 1:00 a.m. to Sunday, November 22 at 6:59 a.m. (PST)

* A portion of the comments posted during the performance will be available to view via the chat replay feature when ready. Comments cannot be posted during the archive viewing period.

Purchase a ticket for the stream.
* A free Plus member ID is required to purchase a ticket for the live stream.
* The live stream may not be available for viewing in certain regions. Please review the live stream's availability in your region before purchasing.
